colors.name: paper
colors.role: background — the drawing sheet, warm off-white (18.1:1 with ink); pure #ffffff is reserved for plate fills where the drawing must sit on the whitest surface available

colors.name: ink
colors.role: all body text, headings, drawing lines, thick and thin rules — 18.1:1 on paper, 18.9:1 on white

colors.name: signal-red
colors.role: the one accent: a single section-drawing line, the active filter mark, the grid marker, the focus ring, the selection — 4.17:1 on paper fails AA normal by 0.33, so the atelier never sets small red text; it is marks and large numerals only, and every red mark is doubled by ink text

colors.name: ink-faint
colors.role: decorative only: the column overlay hairlines, baseline grid, and dimension tick marks — ink at ≈22% over paper; never functional

colors.name: plate
colors.role: the plate surface — pure white cards/plates that sit on the warm sheet so a drawing always reads against the cleanest paper

fonts.role: the drawing hand — thin weights (200/300) carry the entire expressive budget: hairline numerals, display headings, body; where RASTER routes expression through Archivo's width axis, GRID routes it through weight
every Hangul glyph — set at the same thin weights as Inter so a bilingual plate reads as one drawing, not a translation
the architect's pencil — plate numbers, coordinates, dimensions, the running title block; tabular figures so every measurement aligns

texture: None — the paper is flat #fafaf8. The only 'texture' is the exposed construction, drawn three ways: (1) a fixed column overlay of faint ink hairlines at the content's exact frame (one 12-col layer, always on); (2) a baseline grid of 8px hairlines rendered as repeating-linear-gradient inside the section-drawing plate; (3) dimension lines, tick marks, and corner registration crosses drawn into each plate as SVG/HTML. The page wears its own measurement drawing.

motion.name: ease-grid
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) — smooth deceleration, the drawing settles into place; no overshoot, the atelier does not bounce

motion.name: flip-repack
motion.value: 600ms ease-grid on transform; First/Last measured around a flushSync re-render of the filter, inverted inline, played by CSS

motion.name: plate-enter
motion.value: 520ms ease-grid, opacity 0 → 1 and translateY(14px → 0), 60ms stagger per plate; backwards fill so the resting state takes over without a jump

motion.name: section-scrub
motion.value: scroll-pinned: section drawing strokes interpolate dashoffset 1 → 0 and dimension labels fade in, lerp-smoothed scroll progress 0.0–1.0 over one viewport of travel

motion.name: numeral-reveal
motion.value: 720ms ease-grid per glyph, opacity 0 → 1 and translateY(0.5em → 0), 40ms stagger; the 100% keyframe equals the resting style

motion.name: overlay-crossfade
motion.value: 240ms ease-grid, opacity only — the column overlay hairlines redraw ahead of the repack
